notes: Aris Local World Body: promotes Aris as the second full-body citizen in Local 3D alongside Cato. Aris uses the existing authoritative Simulation position and real route-travel pipeline, with a leaner 1.85 m-inspired presentation scale, cyan grounding/selection treatment, and a minimum Local zoom-out readability floor. Region and Planet remain free of citizen body markers. The approved Aris concept sheet is preserved as a canonical visual reference. Bex, Iri, Noma, and Vale remain token-based pending separate rollouts. Assets still does not create physical dimensions, coordinates, equipment, locomotion, collision, or capability truth.
